about:
RFL Manufacturing operates from a facility at 1146 West Hilton Avenue in Phoenix, Arizona. The company focuses on the production of general roof flashings and a proprietary tile roof vent system branded as Coronado Vents™.

Its catalog covers standard flashings used in tile and shingle roofing across Arizona and the Southwest, while the Coronado Vents™ line includes a primary vent and secondary vents engineered to simplify installation, improve roof aesthetics, and reduce overall cost. The company also offers full panel roof systems. All products are distributed exclusively through established roofing distributors rather than sold direct to contractors.

RFL serves the roofing and building-materials sectors, primarily supplying distributors that support residential and commercial roofing projects in the Phoenix metro area and the wider Southwest market.

The company highlights quick turnaround and competitive pricing for local customers, and positions its vent system as a market-moving innovation that delivers a smarter way to vent tile roofs.
